nom: TULA 24-7 Moisture Hydrating Day & Night Cream

avis.titre: For the price, this should be non-comedogenic
avis.texte: I LOVE this product. It feels amazing and leaves your skin so soft. However, even as someone with historically clear skin, this did make me prone to breakouts as it's comedogenic. Unfortunately, my PCP advised against my continued use of it. I feel like, for the price, this product should be non-comodogenic.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product again.
avis.texte: This product is moisturizing and does not bother my sensitive skin.
The Tula face moisturizer was a repeat purchase for me. Super moisturizing and a good amount of product. Also, Ulta tends to run sales on these, which is a plus!

avis.titre: So good my husband stole mine
avis.texte: My everyday moisturizer that is so good my husband is now obsessed and I had to buy him his own. It's hydrating but doesn't leave our skin oily.

I tried this as a sample and unfortunately it clogged my pores. My skin had been really clear, but after using this cream I started getting a lot of tiny bumps all over my face that made my skin look less smooth. The texture feels nice and hydrating, but it was too heavy for my skin. It might work better for people with drier skin types.

I am someone who rarely gets acne. The one time I might get a pimple is around my period. I have dry skin but not senstive. I could try anything under the sun basically. And thsi broke me out. Caused my skin to flake. And it is not cheap. Take that as you will.

I have used this product for years and years and have loved it with no issues. I recently opened a new jar and I've had a severe allergic reaction. Rash, burning, and itching. I've had to discontinue the product. I'm so sad.

I have been buying this product for years, and I mean YEARS. Up until my last purchase, it was the only moisturizer that worked well for my skin and paired well with my makeup. I bought a new jar recently and I have now developed a severe reacfion to this moisturizer. It was so bad that it was burning, itchy and got hives thag required an allergy pill for. I am so sad because it took me forever to find this one to begin with. I like the company but I wish they wouldn't have changed their formula on this product.
This was one of the first moisturizers I've tried and is still the one I think about the most. I love how it made my skin feel, the scent, and the fresh dewy finish it gave me. I miss it every day.

Tumi reduced wrinkles immediately after applying but only lasted a few hours. Not good for sensitive skin. Used the product daily for a week. Developed skin rash and buring face. Discontinued use for 3 months and reapplied. Burning returned immediately after 1 application.

avis.titre: my skin looks so healthy and glowy after use
avis.texte: i love this moisturizer because it feels so lightweight and hydrating without being stick/greasy. it doesn't cause breakouts even if i sleep with it. i always get comments that im glowing when i have it on. my skin looks fresh, bouncy and radiant!!! i used to have combination skin - but lately it's been more dry so this is perfect for me.
The smell .. I dislike scented moisturizers. It's giving grandma. I'm glad I only got the mini size

avis.titre: I will buy this until I die
avis.texte: This is the best moisturizer that I have ever tried, I have used it since middle school and it has never done me wrong. It is a very light formula that is perfect for sensitive skin. It also keeps my skin feeling hydrated all day.

doesn't leave a tacky oily feeling on skin, lightweight, absorbs nicely. doesn't make me break out. i'd recommend. If you want to go more high end, i recommend Dior Capture to everyone. it is 10000/100000

I have a bright red nose with dry skin and pimples ever since getting pregnant in 2022, been pregnant basically since and still will be until April 2026. I've fought so hard with this I'm pretty much known to be Rudolph now. Don't know even how I came by this moisturizer or how it got in my cabinet but I opened the box the other day and started using a finger tip amount all over my face and woke up and my nose looked like actual normal colored skin and no flaky skin after the first night. I'm very happy with it so far. Only been using one time at night after a shower may that be 3 to 5 times a week.

I was looking for both an AM/PM face moisturizer and stumbled upon this product considering I use the face cleanser for PM face cleaning. I would highly recommend this product to someone who has either oily or dry skin. It is very hydrating but does not leave a dewy substance on the skin. Very refreshing.

Recently switched from Clinique moisture surge and am happy about it. This product feels super light but also very moisturizing. I feel like the moisture lasts longer than other products Ive used. Very light, clean scent.

avis.titre: I repurchase every time I start to run low
avis.texte: Makes my skin feel and look so moisturized, I have been repurchasing this product for years now and absolutely love it. My mom is 55 and loves it as well, great for all ages of skin and I will continue to repurchase!

I already see positive visible results! I've had a very hard time finding a moisturizer that doesn't upset my very sensitive skin. An associate in the store in my state recommended the brand Tula and I'm so glad she did. I love the cult classic cleanser and this moisturizer as well as the rose eye balm. I'm sticking with this brand. Highly recommend!
Perfect for winter. Keep my face moisturized and did not break me out. 10/10 would recommend to anyone.
This is THE BEST face cream ever. Both my daughter (teenage acne) and I (53) use this daily and it's amazing. Totally hydrating, non greasy, no smell, sheer perfection.

avis.titre: Used to love, now causing major skin reaction
avis.texte: I have used this product for years & loved it. Lately I have been having an extreme reaction on my face and neck, and now believe this cream is the issue. I stopped using, my skin cleared, and when I reintroduced to test it out, the reaction returned. Face very hot, swollen, itchy. It looks like I had a chemical peel. They must have changed the formula. I am so upset but will be switching out all Tula products.

avis.titre: Tula moisturizing cream Day and night
avis.texte: Very light and extremely hydrating a little goes a long way well worth the price

avis.titre: My First Empty and Worth Every Drop
avis.texte: I tend to buy into trends, if a product looks promising, I'll try it. But it's rare to find something that truly works with my skin and plays well with the rest of my routine. Tula's 24/7 moisturizer was the first skincare product I actually used down to the very last drop. It absorbs quickly, and I saw results from the very first application. The best part is that the effect doesn't fade over time, it keeps delivering. My only complaint is the packaging. Having to dip my fingers in the jar feels like I'm risking contamination of an amazing (and pricey) product. A pump or airless jar would make it perfect.

avis.titre: Used to love it, now possibly causing rash
avis.texte: I used to love this face cream, as it felt so good on my skin. But recently my husband (who uses this cream) and I developed reactions on the face and neck areas. I wonder if this is the culprit, and if they changed the formula.

avis.titre: I was looking for a new m
avis.texte: I was looking for a new moisturizer and came across reviews for this. They did not steer me wrong! It is lightweight, not greasy, and yet does a great job of moisturizing.

Tula's 24/7 Moisture cream is excellent as an everyday moisturizer. I use it after applying my Tretinoin treatment product and it keeps my skin from getting irritated and dry. My oily skin can wear this without appearing greasy and feeling slick.

avis.titre: I found this product a fe
avis.texte: I found this product a few years ago, and it's been a staple since. Twice a day. Without fail. My skin is smooth, soft and never dry. Buy in bulk!
i use am/pm daily and its a great, lightweight but hydrating moisturizer! it doesn't make my skin feel too sticky or greasy after

avis.titre: I love that I can use thi
avis.texte: I love that I can use this both day and night. One less bottle sitting around and one less to buy. I have had people comment that my skin is glowing. This moisturize is a definitely a keeper.
We love the moisturizer and all the Tula products we have tried.
This moisturizer is a staple in my routine. Highly recommend!

This was such a nice moisturizer to use so happy i got this complementry to try and keep and I love the fact that it's all in one for all day 24hour wear easy to apply feels nice and cooling when applying and no smells thank god I hate smelly moisturizers makes my skin look and feel good and doesn't feel sticky very smooth and easy to apply

I like this cream, it seems to hydrate without being greasy. it does not break out my skin. the ultra intense day and night cream totally drains my skin of moisture overnight. it literally does the opposite of what it should do.

avis.titre: The Best Moisturizer Except For the Packaging…
avis.texte: This is my HOLY GRAIL moisturizer, I always snag it when there's a discount in my Ulta App or a sale going on. But the past 2 times I've purchased it, the coating on the packaging is flaking off and it's really really bad. I can't touch the outside of it or else my hands will be coated in tiny blue flakes. I see there's a few other reviews that also share about the packaging flaw- just wish I could travel with it in my cosmetics bag without worrying about the rest of my products being covered in blue flakes.
I love this moisturizer!! I use it every day over Tula sunscreen. Have never been disappointed by any Tula product
The product itself is great but both times I've purchased this product, the packaging flakes off and leaves tiny blue flakes on my fingers as i go to get the product out.

avis.titre: Makes My Skin Oily Within a Couple of Hours
avis.texte: I used to like it. It isn't too thick, absorbs quickly, but it makes my skin so oily within a couple of hours.

the moisturizer works alright, i did have some pilling sometimes if i didn't wait for long enough between products. the main issue is the issue of the jar just started peeling off into little chips, and now i have these micro plastic chips stuck all over the inside of my bag, phone, etc. it's really strange and i've never seen this happen before.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I was a little weary of the price point for this but I've been using this for a few weeks now and I am ok with it. It keeps my face moisturized and the scent is a light floral when you 1st put it on. It disappears which is great! Highly recommend!

I've been using this for a couple years because my skin is very sensitive and nothing else would work for me not even supper expensive name brands this product is exceptional even out your skin tone and provides great moisture i highly recommend it.

I kept seeing little blue dots on my face while I was doing my make up and couldn't figure out why then I realized the paint on the jar comes off, that's the only negative thing I could say about this. I have extremely oily skin and it doesn't feel like I have anything on my face, but it does its job.

This is the second time I've ordered this cream. It is light, creamy, and very moisturizing. I mix a couple drops of bronzer with it and forego makeup during the summer. Am gradually trying other Tula products, but this for sure a staple. So far, I really like the brand. Also timely shipping which I appreciate.

💧 TULA • 24/7 weightless day and night gel cream 💧 This is one of my all time favorite products I've received. I went in with zero expectations, knowing nothing about the product. Complimentary product received in exchange for my HONEST review what is this witchcraft at tula ?! It's really magical and out of this world. I was never expecting so much from a moisturizer. This is my favorite type of moisturizer, a lightweight cooling cream. It's great for all skin types, especially for my acne prone combination skin. When I wake up the next morning after using this, my skin feels texture-less, smooth, soft like velvet, hydrated, and glowing. I couldn't believe how much I loved this. It's a remarkably noticeable difference, compared to when I use other moisturizers Few things have ever made my skin so soft and smooth, it hydrates your skin like no other I compared other creams and it's a very noticeable difference. I don't get anywhere near the same texture-less, soft, hydrated feeling with others I'll be using it everyday. It would become permanent in my routine if not for the price!

I love this moisturizer keeps my skin smooth and breakout free! The product is amazing. The packaging on the other hand. I don't know if it was just my packaging or if it happens often but I was finding blue specks everyone on my face on my hands. But overall great product, just disappointed in packaging.

I love the results I get using this product. However, for the price, the external areas of the container kept stripping and blue particles gets on my fingers/hands, into the container and on my face when applying. I finally had to just scrub the whole blue areas off the container. If my situation isn't isolated, I would say this packaging is kind of a cheap vibes for the price of the product and more investment needs to go into the packaging.
I love this moisturizer! Smells lovely, easy applicator, my face feels so soft, but not heavy. I will continue to replenish!
This is my everyday moisturizer. Not too heavy but still feels nourishing. Great to prep your skin before make up.

My 13 y/o daughter and I both use this daily moisturizer. She is sensitive to gluten and this product is gluten free and leaves her skin smooth. I've been using this for a few years and I love it in the winter because it moisturizes without feeling heavy.
This is the best moisturizer I've ever used. It's the perfect texture and weight. It soaks into the skin so well, leaving it glowing! Will repurchase Every. Single. Time.

Pricey but a dang good moisturizer! Mainly used at night as it is on the thicker and heavier side which i like for my night time skin routine. I find this to also be comparable to the skin balm from Glossier.

I love the original 24-7 Moisture cream, the scent is super soft, the cream glides on smoothly, and leaves your skin feeling soft with no residue. I have super sensitive skin and I am able to use it both in the morning and evening with no issues.

This moisturizer is the first I have ever happily used daily. Previous types have felt oily or felt like they didn't absorb quickly enough, but this moisturizer feels coola nd wonderful on application and absorbs quickly enough that I don't have to wait to apply sunscreen or makeup.
I've finally found a moisturizer that feels light, and doesn't make my skin feel sticky or oily.

I really love the gel like consistency of the product. It's very lightweight & doesn't feel heavy or greasy and it really allows my skin to "breathe". I haven't broke out with this product so that's a plus. It's great for both day and night use but I love to use it in the evening and wake up to hydrated soft skin. I definitely will be stocking up on the cream.

I have always had dry skin and have had a hard time finding moisturizer that really hydrate without leaving my skin feeling greasy. This is the first Tula product I've tried and I'm sold! I got it in sale but I like it so much that I will pay full price. I also eat to try more of their products now.

For the price I would have expected better packaging. Just feels like cheap plastic. The product itself is smooth, absorbed fast and had a pleasant scent! It is a nice product but not worth it at full price, so I'm glad I got it half off.

Lightweight and not greasy at all which is my favorite. I have acne prone dry skin and this is the perfect balanced moisturizer that doesn't feel heavy and clog my pores but gives me the moisture that my skin needs!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love the 24-7 Weightless Day & Night Gel Cream — the texture is a dream: super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky feeling. I use it both morning and night, and it keeps my skin hydrated without feeling heavy — perfect for combo or oily skin. Makeup goes on smoothly over it, and it plays well with SPF and foundation.

I love this for the most part! It definitely absorbs quick and leaves me glowing! not too sure if it's helping with my wrinkles. it doesn't rly seem to be. I used IT confidence in your beauty sleep for years before trying this and I feel like that helped with wrinkles better, but obviously this has cleaner ingredients so.. :) i made the switch for that reason. I would purchase this again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Omg have never tried this brand before and I hate that I've been missing out! It's so lightweight but still moisturizing. It doesn't dry down weird my skin still feels hydrated but not tight. Works super well with all of my makeup and other skincare. Didn't really notice a scent which is good cuz I can be picky!

This has been in my cart for a LONG TIME. I saw it recently on sale and decided to purchase. Honestly this is terrible. It absorbs quickly but I do not feel moisturized. In fact it feel drying. Super disappointed
This is my favorite moisturizer from the line!!!! My skin is ULTRA Sensitive, but my face Loves this product ! Thank you Tula!

avis.titre: Burned my skin. Remember to patch test ladies
avis.texte: Immediately caused a burning sensation that lasted for about 30 mins after immediately washing off. If you have sensitive skin or are sensitive to heavily perfumed products I would not recommend.
I try so many others and keep coming back. It is just so good.

avis.titre: The best moisturizer I have used
avis.texte: My sister recommended this moisturizer to me, and it is now the only one I use. It does great with my sensitive skin and keeps my skin deeply moisturized throughout the day/night as my skin is also very dry. I will continue to use this product!

I have dry and very sensitive skin. While my general redness did persist, I'm happy to say this moisturizer didn't give me any major breakouts. Overall, this product was moisturizing and preformed best when applied to damp skin. I would recommend using it at nighttime so it has a chance to really soak in. I felt that this moisturizer sat on top of my skin a little bit. I use bare minerals complexion rescue tinted moisturizer, which I noticed tends to pill when I use TULA beforehand, even when I wait 20+ minutes after applying the moisturizer. My partner likes this moisturizer, and I may continue to buy it for him. But I will likely move on to something else.

Received a sample size as my birthday gift, fell in love with this moisturizer immediately! It melts into your skin & it leaves you hydrated all day long. Im so happy I finally found a moisturizer that keeps me hydrated all day long! 🩷

I have combo skin and am not prone to acne. I really like this moisturizer! Its lightweight and the smell is pleasant imo. I just wear a thicker layer overnight and it works great. Makeup layers well over the top. I love to snag this every time its on sale!

used to swear by this for my sensitive skin til i ran out of my last one- it was in a tube vs. this packaging, unscented and had a different texture. this one has a strong scent and is more creamy in texture. sad they switched up

I received a sample size of this and honestly this product smells so bad I can't believe it's so popular. It smells like baby powder or like a scented body wipe or something. The smell lasts all day and doesn't go away.
I like the feel on my skin. It's moisturizing yet not too thick or greasy. it's a little spendy but I don't need to use very much.

I got one of those free big size sample and i was so excited to try this! Wish i read the reviews but ya live and you learn! I never really had issues with acne until using this. I have had almost cyst like acne on my foregead since i added this product into my routine in December. On dry skin or freshley washed skin, this product stung and left my forehead red. Hopefully it works for someone but the pros were it felt lightweight and buildable! Wish it wasnt so expensive, lightweight, and didnt cause me any reactions. Would recommend steering clear if you have a histpry of sensitive skin (even if its a free sample!)

avis.titre: Not for sensitive or acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I don't have sensitive skin and pretty much tolerate everything, however, this one and the Vit C brightening drops, just like I saw on other reviews, I feel like my skin is burning. Eventually it started peeling and I also got whiteheads (which I never does and I don't have acne-prone skin) on some areas so not for daily use nor for sensitive skin. So this is a no for me unfortunately.

I love this stuff !!!! I've never found a moisturizer that controls my dry skin. My makeup would always be flaky …. . But Let Me Say This Stuff Is Magic where have you been all my life If you have dry skin you know the struggle Look no further Tula is truly amazing and you will love love love your face thank you Tula

avis.titre: Great moisturizer for day and night!
avis.texte: I've evening Tula hydrating day & night cream for 5 years. I love how light weight and moisturizing this cream is. I'm constantly getting compliments on how clean my skin is and I owe it all to my Tula products!

avis.titre: Really enjoying this moisturizer for AM/PM
avis.texte: I have been using this for about one week, but I haven't been using it day and night every day just mostly at night. Here in TN. we are having temps in the teens and single digits at night so it's really, really late when I get to bed and during the mornings I have been hibernating, lol! If I have to go somewhere during the day I'll do my skin routine. I am really loving the moisture that my skin is absorbing and my skin looks more brighter, fresher. The forehead lines and the 11's are all looking less noticeable and hopefully the marionette lines will fade as well. Really enjoying this moisturizer. I will be sticking with it since it's for both day and night and non-greasy, just softer skin and less noticeable lines.

avis.titre: Hydrating day & night cream is the best!
avis.texte: I have been using the hydrating day and night cream for well over a year now and my skin is so soft and looks great. My friends have even noticed and have asked me what I use. I let them know that Tula products are the best!!
Perfect staple moisturizer. Thick texture but doesn't feel heavy or greasy on my face.
Love this cream! No greasy feeling and does not break you out.

I've been using this for a couple years and love it because it's perfect for day and night use. Doesn't feel heavy or greasy but gives maximum hydration results. Planning to upgrade to the 24-7 one with collagen soon
Love love love this cream! Leaves my skin feeling amazing! Definitely hydrates my skin and is light feeling so it doesn't feel thick and oily!
I've been using this cream 2x a day and love how soft my skin feels. It doesn't get dry throughout the day. Would highly recommend!

Simply amazing hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. A little bit goes a long way. I use it in the morning and at night and have seen big improvement in my skin…. less redness, increased brightness and decreased fine lines. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a great hydrating cream that is clean.
I received sample for this cream and i liked it and i ordered full size for this cream
I got a free sample of this, and it is amazing. I will definitely be purchasing a full size once I run out, expensive but worth it!

This moisturizer is so good. It's thick without feeling too heavy or clogging your pores. It doesn't have a heavy scent. , which is so nice. It's easy to apply and leaves skin feeling super hydrated afterwards.
I use this night and day. It's perfect for my sensitive skin.

I really wanted to love this because I love the cult classic wash and needed a new moisturizer for winter. However, it felt greasy on my skin and made me break out terribly. Small bumps and white heads all over my cheeks despite my t-zone usually being the problem spot.

I usually use juice beauty moisturizers but have been getting a red patch on my smile line (sort of like a rash with little pimple-like bumps)—been using this tula moisturizer for about a week & the red rash is almost gone!
My favorite moisturizer! My skin feels so soft and plump and looks well-hydrated! I love that it doesn't make my skin look or feel oily after use
I like to use this moisturizer at night. I like that it is hydrating but doesn't leave my face feeling greasy. Works great on my sensitive skin.
This moisturizer made my face breakout sooooo bad. I was blemish free before using this, sensitive skin beware! Caused so much acne and inflammation.
Tula 24/7 gives my skin much needed hydration without clogging my pores. I love it!
Light but deeply moisturizing, and keeps skin hydrated in dry winter weather!
Amazing product. I use this every day. It makes my makeup application go on so smooth because my skin is hydrated.
This is my daughter's absolute favorite. She struggles with combination sensitive skin and this is one of the best products we have found. Extremely moisturizing without leaving any oily residue.
I love how this is not heavy and makes my face feel very natural when wearing it

I initially recieved this item as a sample from Ulta and figured I would give it a try. I am now hooked! I finished my sample size and just purchased the jumbo! My skin has never looked better and people have complimented my skin. I am now more confident to leave the house without makeup!

avis.titre: Love love love!!!!!!! Best face cream
avis.texte: This is my favorite face cream for any concern you have. I have tried many other products and always come back to this tula product and it's here to stay.
Love how soft it makes my skin feel. A very good quality hydrating day moisturizer that keeps my skin feeling quenched all day. Acne scars have since disappeared since using Tula. I love it all
This moisturizer is "ok", but for my mature dry skin Cerave works a little bit better. Not worth the price. Will not repurchase.

I bought this product to try out as i have rarely found a facial moisturizer i like or that agrees with my exzema prone skin. I fell in love with this one! Its smooth to go on, leaves my skin hydrated all day and doesnt itritate my skin or break me out. I bought the 1.5 oz size and it lasted me about four months of day and night use as you dont need a lot of product for it to do the job! Im very impressed and would recommend to anyone who is looking for a lightweight and sensitive skin friendly daily moisturizer!
